phrases.romaji: Irasshaimase. Makura o osagashi desu ka?
phrases.english: Welcome! Are you looking for a pillow?
phrases.japanese: いらっしゃいませ。枕をお探しですか？
phrases.practicePrompt: Tell the clerk you are looking for a pillow that helps with neck pain.
phrases.exampleResponse: Hai, kubi ga itaku naranai makura o sagashite imasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: はい、首が痛くならない枕を探しています。

phrases.romaji: Katame no makura wa arimasu ka?
phrases.japanese: 硬めの枕はありますか？
phrases.practicePrompt: As the clerk, say that you have memory foam (low-rebound) pillows over here.
phrases.exampleResponse: Kochira ni teihanshou makura ga gozaimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: こちらに低反発枕がございます。

phrases.romaji: Aomuke ni neru to takasa ga choudo ii desu ga, yokomuki dato hikuku kanjimasu.
phrases.english: When I lie on my back the height is just right, but it feels too low when I sleep on my side.
phrases.japanese: 仰向けに寝ると高さがちょうどいいですが、横向きだと低く感じます。
phrases.practicePrompt: As the clerk, suggest a pillow with adjustable height.
phrases.exampleResponse: Takasa wo chousei dekiru makura mo gozaimasu yo.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 高さを調整できる枕もございますよ。

phrases.romaji: Kore, fitto-kan ga sugoku ii desu ne. Kore ni shimasu.
phrases.english: This one feels really comfortable and fits well. I'll take this one.
phrases.japanese: これ、フィット感がすごくいいですね。これにします。
phrases.practicePrompt: As the clerk, thank the customer and offer to guide them to the register.
phrases.exampleResponse: Arigatou gozaimasu. Reji e goannai shimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: ありがとうございます。レジへご案内します。

phrases.romaji: Makura kabā mo issho ni ikaga desu ka?
phrases.english: Would you like a pillowcase to go with it?
phrases.japanese: 枕カバーも一緒にいかがですか？
phrases.practicePrompt: Say 'Yes, please show me washable ones.'
phrases.exampleResponse: Hai, araweru mono o misete kudasai.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: はい、洗えるものを見せてください。

phrases.romaji: Sumimasen, toshokan no kaado wo tsukuritai n desu ga.
phrases.english: Excuse me, I would like to make a library card.
phrases.japanese: すみません、図書館のカードを作りたいのですが。
phrases.practicePrompt: Ask the visitor to show their ID.
phrases.exampleResponse: Mibun shoumeisho wo misete itadakemasu ka?
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 身分証明書を見せていただけますか。

phrases.romaji: Kono hon wa doko ni arimasu ka?
phrases.japanese: この本はどこにありますか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Tell them the book is in the history section on the second floor.
phrases.exampleResponse: Ni-kai no rekishi koonaa ni arimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 2階の歴史コーナーにあります。

phrases.romaji: Kono jishuushitsu no seki wa yoyaku ga hitsuyou desu ka?
phrases.english: Do I need a reservation for these study room seats?
phrases.japanese: この自習室の席は予約が必要ですか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Explain that weekends require a reservation, but weekdays are first-come, first-served.
phrases.exampleResponse: Shuumatsu wa yoyaku ga hitsuyou desu ga, heijitsu wa senchakujun desu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 週末は予約が必要ですが、平日は先着順です。

phrases.romaji: Kono hon wo karitai n desu ga.
phrases.english: I would like to borrow these books.
phrases.japanese: この本を借りたいのですが。
phrases.practicePrompt: Ask them to present their library card.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 図書館カードを出してください。

phrases.romaji: Kashidashi kikan wa ni-shuukan desu ga, enchou wa kanou desu ka?
phrases.english: The lending period is two weeks, but is an extension possible?
phrases.japanese: 貸出期間は2週間ですが、延長は可能ですか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Reply that they can extend it once online if there are no reservations.
phrases.exampleResponse: Yoyaku ga nakereba, onrain de ichido enchou dekimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 予約がなければ、オンラインで一度延長できます。

phrases.romaji: Kyuukanbi ni hon wo henkyaku shitai baai wa, dou sureba ii desu ka?
phrases.english: What should I do if I want to return books on days the library is closed?
phrases.japanese: 休館日に本を返却したい場合は、どうすればいいですか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Instruct them to place the books into the return slot outside the entrance.
phrases.exampleResponse: Iriguchi no soto ni aru henkyakubokkusu ni irete kudasai.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 入口の外にある返却ボックスに入れてください。

phrases.romaji: Honjitsu wa ojikan wo itadaki, arigatou gozaimasu.
phrases.english: Thank you for taking the time to meet with me today.
phrases.japanese: 本日はお時間をいただき、ありがとうございます。
phrases.practicePrompt: Respond by saying 'You're welcome. Please take a seat.'
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: こちらこそ。どうぞお座りください。

phrases.romaji: Kantan ni jikoshoukai wo onegai shimasu.
phrases.japanese: 簡単に自己紹介をお願いします。
phrases.practicePrompt: Introduce yourself by stating your name and saying you look forward to working together.
phrases.exampleResponse: Tanaka Tarou to moushimasu. Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 田中太郎と申します。よろしくお願いします。

phrases.romaji: Heisha wo shibou shita riyuu wa nan desu ka.
phrases.english: What is your reason for applying to our company?
phrases.japanese: 弊社を志望した理由は何ですか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Explain that you were drawn to the company's products.
phrases.exampleResponse: Kisha no seihin ni miryoku wo kanjita kara desu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 貴社の製品に魅力を感じたからです。

phrases.romaji: Anata no chousho wo shigoto ni dou ikasemasu ka.
phrases.english: How can you leverage your strengths in this job?
phrases.japanese: あなたの長所を仕事にどう活かせますか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Explain that your communication skills will help improve team productivity.
phrases.exampleResponse: Komyunikeeshon nouryoku de chiimu no seisansei wo ageraremasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: コミュニケーション能力でチームの生産性を上げられます。

phrases.english: Do you have any questions for us?
phrases.japanese: 何か質問はありますか。
phrases.practicePrompt: Ask what the atmosphere of the workplace is like.
phrases.exampleResponse: Shokuba no fun'iki wa dou desu ka.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: 職場の雰囲気はどうですか。

phrases.romaji: Kekka wa isshuukan inai ni gorenraku itashimasu.
phrases.english: We will contact you with the results within a week.
phrases.japanese: 結果は一週間以内にご連絡いたします。
phrases.practicePrompt: Thank them and say you will be looking forward to hearing from them.
phrases.exampleResponse: Arigatou gozaimasu. Renraku wo omachi shite orimasu.
phrases.exampleResponseJapanese: ありがとうございます。連絡をお待ちしております。
